critical_finding: NewsArticle.content (rich text from CMS) is rendered via ReactMarkdown WITHOUT sanitization in HomeSection.tsx:993. ReactMarkdown by default allows raw HTML passthrough. An admin creating a news article with would achieve stored XSS on the public portal.
recommended_fixes: HomeSection.tsx:993 - Add rehype-sanitize to ReactMarkdown: <ReactMarkdown components={{}} rehypePlugins={[rehypeSanitize]}>{content}</ReactMarkdown> OR pre-sanitize with sanitizeHtml() from '@/lib/sanitize-html'

Consider wrapping ALL CMS rich-text fields (NewsArticle.content, Regulation.content, Procedure.requirements, Procedure.steps, Guide.steps, FAQ.answer) with sanitizeHtml() before rendering, even if currently rendered as JSX text (defense in depth)
Add unit test for sanitizeHtml() with XSS payloads
Audit any future components that may render CMS rich-text content
